name: The Tale of Drac de Na Coca
source:
Four companions brave the wilds near the city of Palmensis to confront the vile dragon, Drac de Na Coca.  Drawn their by your Patron, will you stand against the oncoming threat despite the risks with your friends and lover? 

[From [url=https://ssekkaha.itch.io/drac-de-na-coca]Itch.io[/url]]
